Coverage_Description: Group medical reimbursement for hospitalization and surgery in Asia (including Australia and New Zealand), with HK$5,000,000 annual and HK$12,500,000 lifetime limits; optional outpatient, maternity, dental and optical benefits, plus worldwide emergency assistance
customer requirement: Minimum 3 full-time employees for the core plan (and each optional benefit); employees in the same class must join the same core plan and deductible
price structure: Annual renewable premium; deductible options HK$0/HK$16,000/HK$25,000 per policy year (higher deductible for lower premium)
additional informations: Conversion option for companies with 10+ employees: insured aged 65 or below, medically underwritten and covered for at least 2 consecutive
